text.p: Digital Biometrics Inc said it is reviewing strategies and priorities, and management expects certain one-time charges in a range of $0.15 to $0.20 per share to refocus its business.
It said the charges include severance expenses.
Digital Biometrics manufactures identification and security products.

"Our top priorities are to build on our leadership position in the domestic law enforcement market for live-scan fingerprint applications by pursuing opportunities in both the United States and abroad and to capitalize on the interest in our innovative products for the gaming industry, a new market for our imaging technologies," said retiring chairman Jack Klingert in a statement.
